title: DNA Extraction
author: Tsu-Chun Hung
materials: Put in the automated DNA extraction machine

steps.title: Add beads and buffers
steps.instruction: Prepare the extraction tube by adding the following reagents:

steps.title: Add sample to tube
steps.instruction: Collect 10–20 mg of the biological sample and add it to the same 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Crush sample in mixmill
steps.instruction: Place the tube in a mixmill and run at 30 rpm for 4 minutes (00:04:00).

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 17.0 × g, 25 °C for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads to well 1
steps.instruction: Add 125 µL of magnetic beads (10 mg/mL) to the first well of a 96‑deep‑well plate; shake the bead bottle and pipette before use.

steps.title: Add isopropanol to well 1
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL of isopropanol to the first well of the 96‑well plate.

steps.title: Add lysate to well 1 (last)
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of the sample lysate (from the 15 mL centrifuge microtube) to the first well of the 96‑deep‑well plate; this addition should be performed after all other reagents for that well.

steps.title: Add isopropanol to well 2
steps.instruction: Add 400 µL of isopropanol to the second well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Add 80 % ethanol to wells 3‑4
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 80 % ethanol to the third well and another 300 µL to the fourth well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Add DD water to well 5
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of double‑distilled (DD) water to the fifth well of the 96‑deep‑well plate.

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate to tube
steps.instruction: Add 267 µL of 10 M ammonium acetate (stored at 4 °C) to the 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Collect eluted DNA
steps.instruction: After the extraction is complete, collect 100 µL of the eluted sample to use as DNA template for downstream experiments.
